stocks_screen.purpose: High-clarity stock tracking, showing primary ticker details and a mini watchlist.

layout.primary_ticker: Left side (160x120): Large ticker symbol, huge price, positive/negative delta pill
layout.chart_area: Bottom left (160x80): Line graph of day performance
layout.watchlist: Right side (140x220): Stacked 3-item list. Each item has symbol (left), price/delta (right)

stocks_screen.motion: Price flashes slightly green/red on update payload. Chart line draws incrementally left to right. Watchlist numbers cross-fade on update.
stocks_screen.interactions: Tap watchlist item to set as primary ticker.
stocks_screen.rendering_notes: Chart uses TFT_eSPI drawLine from mapped coords, clear previous lines by drawing overlapping black rects. Price updates require fixed-width fonts to prevent jitter.
stocks_screen.prompt: A mini stock market dashboard on a 320x240 dark display. The left half focuses on one stock (like NVDA) with a massive price font, a green positive percentage pill, and a minimal green line chart spanning the bottom. The right half features a column of 3 smaller watchlist items with their tickers and prices. The aesthetic is Bloomberg terminal meets ultra-modern clean dark mode.
stocks_screen.motion_prompt: When stock data updates, the massive price number quickly flashes a subtle green backdrop and the line chart smoothly extends its path to the right.
